## Beta — Cards served directly by the integration

HACS allows one category per repository, so back in the day ChronoTask (an *integration*) shipped its cards by copying them into `<config>/www/chronotask` and asking you to add them as Lovelace resources. Since 1.4.0 the cards register themselves; this beta removes the last piece of the old mechanism.

- The cards are now **served directly from the integration folder**, at a path that contains the version (`/chronotask/<version>/…`). Every release has a new URL, so no cache — browser, CDN or reverse proxy such as Cloudflare — can serve an old copy, and the shared module follows the same version automatically. Since the URL changes with every release, the files can now be cached, so cards load faster.
- **Nothing is written into `<config>/www` anymore.** The copies left there by previous versions are removed at startup (only ChronoTask's own files; the folder is deleted only if it ends up empty).
- **Old manual resources keep working**: `/local/chronotask/…` now points to the integration folder too (without cache), so you can still remove them whenever you like.
- The version shown in the browser console is now read from the card's own URL.
- New tests for the frontend registration and the cleanup (41 in total).

Also includes everything in 1.7.1-beta1 (cleanup, calendar fix for slots that started the day before, planner rename without restart, minimum Home Assistant 2024.7).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.7.1-beta1...v1.7.1-beta2
